titleZh: 用耳朵认识星云：数据如何变成声音

sources.title: NASA APOD · Sonified: Eagle Nebula Pillars（2026-10-18 专题）
Chandra X-ray Center · Sonification Collection（方法背景，2020）

cet4.title: A Different Way to Meet the Stars
cet4.summary: 从 10 月 18 日的 NASA 星云声音化专题了解数据呈现；温度练习和课堂建议为原创教学示例。

paragraphs.text: A picture is not the only way to explore information about space. On October 18, 2026, NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day featured a sound version of the Eagle Nebula’s famous pillars. The presentation combines an image with sounds created from data. It invites people to consider how information normally shown to the eyes can also be presented to the ears.
paragraphs.translation: 图片并非探索太空信息的唯一方式。2026 年 10 月 18 日，NASA“每日一天文图”展示了鹰状星云著名柱状结构的声音版本。这个展示将图像与根据数据制作的声音结合起来，引导人们思考，通常用眼睛看的信息如何也能通过耳朵呈现。

paragraphs.text: In this example, a line moves across the image from left to right. The vertical position of the recorded light determines the pitch: higher positions produce higher sounds. The Chandra X-ray Center explained this method in an earlier project release in 2020. The recent feature introduces that existing approach to another audience; it does not mean that the technique was first invented this week.
paragraphs.translation: 在这个例子中，一条线从图像左侧移向右侧。记录光线的垂直位置决定音高：位置越高，声音越高。钱德拉 X 射线中心在 2020 年较早的项目发布中解释过这种方法。近期专题把已有方法介绍给另一批受众，并不意味着这项技术是在本周首次发明的。

paragraphs.text: The sounds represent observations; they should not be mistaken for a microphone recording made beside the stars. This difference is important. To understand a pattern, listeners need to know what each sound stands for. An explanation of the rules works like the key on a map. Without it, a strong impression may be enjoyable but difficult to connect with the information.
paragraphs.translation: 声音代表观测资料，不应被误当成在恒星旁用麦克风录下的声音。这种区别很重要。要理解一种规律，听者需要知道每种声音代表什么。对规则的解释就像地图上的图例；没有它，强烈的感受也许令人愉快，却难以与信息对应起来。

paragraphs.text: Presenting the same material in more than one form can make a lesson more accessible. Some learners may notice a change while listening that they missed while looking. Others may prefer the picture and its written description. A useful classroom would offer these choices and ask students which part helped them. It would not assume that one new format must work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.translation: 用不止一种形式呈现相同材料，可以让课程更容易参与。有些学习者可能在聆听时注意到观看时漏掉的变化，另一些则可能更喜欢图片及其文字说明。有帮助的课堂会提供这些选择，并询问学生哪部分对自己有用，而不会假定一种新形式对所有人都同样有效。

paragraphs.text: Imagine a simple exercise in which students turn a week of temperature readings into notes. They could keep the rule constant, using higher notes for higher temperatures. After listening, they could compare their conclusions with the original numbers. This would make the sound meaningful rather than mysterious. A creative presentation supports learning best when people can follow the connection between an experience and the evidence behind it.
paragraphs.translation: 设想一个简单练习：学生把一周的气温读数变成音符。他们可以保持规则不变，用更高的音符表示更高的气温。聆听后，再把结论与原始数字比较。这样，声音就具有可理解的意义，而不只是神秘的效果。当人们能够理清体验与背后证据的联系时，有创意的呈现最能支持学习。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 在声音化规则中指声音的高低，与音量大小不同。

examples.text: The singer began at a low pitch and gradually moved higher.
examples.translation: 歌手从较低音高开始，逐渐唱高。

examples.text: These two notes have the same pitch but different volumes.
examples.translation: 这两个音符音高相同，但音量不同。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指人工生成的声音对应观测信息，而非直接录下天体发出的声响。

examples.text: Each circle on the chart represents one student.
examples.translation: 图表上的每个圆代表一名学生。

examples.text: The colour represents water depth on this map.
examples.translation: 这张地图上的颜色代表水深。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指温度与音高之间的转换规则在练习中保持一致。

examples.text: Keep the room temperature constant during the experiment.
examples.translation: 实验期间保持室温不变。

examples.text: The team used a constant scale to compare all the drawings.
examples.translation: 团队用保持不变的比例比较所有图画。

questions.prompt: What does the passage mainly suggest about presenting data through sound?
options: It makes written explanations less useful to learners.
It proves that images contain too little information.
It can support understanding when the mapping rules are clear.
It is chiefly valuable as a recording of distant stars.
questions.explanation: 全文既介绍声音化的可能性，也反复要求解释规则、核对原始资料，因此 C 概括最完整。A、B 把新增形式误写为取代原有形式；D 则混淆了数据转换与现场录音。

questions.prompt: What determines pitch in the featured example?
options: The date when the image was published.
The vertical position of light in the image.
The speed at which the listener reads the text.
The size of the screen showing the image.
questions.explanation: 第二段明确说垂直位置决定音高，位置越高声音越高，选 B。A 混淆日期与编码规则，C、D 则未被文章作为控制音高的因素。

questions.prompt: Why does the author compare an explanation of the rules to a map key?
options: Both make the presentation appear more surprising.
Both remove the need to inspect original information.
Both require every learner to use the same format.
Both explain how a sign corresponds to information.
questions.explanation: 第三段先提出听者需要知道声音代表什么，再以地图图例作类比，说明规则建立符号与信息的对应关系，D 正确。B 与后文核对原始数字的要求相反。

questions.prompt: Which classroom practice would the author probably support?
options: Offering sound, images and text, then asking what helped each learner.
Using sound alone because it is the newest form of presentation.
Letting students change the rule midway without explaining it.
Judging understanding by how dramatic the sound feels.
questions.explanation: 第四段强调提供多种选择并询问学习者的体验，因此 A 最符合文意。B 假定一种新形式适合所有人，C 破坏一致规则，D 只看感受而非理解。

questions.prompt: The word “constant” in paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to _____.
options: pleasant to hear
easy to replace
unchanged during the exercise
different for each reading
questions.explanation: 第五段举例用更高音符对应更高温度，并要求之后与数字比较，因此规则须保持不变，constant 对应 C。D 会破坏前后一致的对应关系。

cet6.title: When Astronomical Data Become Audible
cet6.summary: 由星云声音化专题讨论数据编码、可及性与解释责任；课堂实验为假设，不是项目成效报告。

paragraphs.text: The familiar assumption that astronomy is primarily visual becomes less secure when an image is translated into sound. On October 18, 2026, NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day featured a sonification of the Eagle Nebula’s pillars. Sonification translates recorded data into audible features. The result is an interpretation of observations through another sensory channel, rather than a claim that a microphone has captured the stars directly. Its interest lies in making relationships available to a different kind of attention.
paragraphs.translation: 当图像被转换为声音时，天文学主要依赖视觉这一熟悉的假定就不再那么牢固。2026 年 10 月 18 日，NASA“每日一天文图”展示了鹰状星云柱状结构的数据声音化作品。声音化把记录的数据转为可听见的特征。其结果是通过另一感官渠道呈现观测资料，而非声称用麦克风直接录下了恒星。它的意义在于让不同类型的注意方式都能接触信息中的关系。

paragraphs.text: In the featured piece, a scan progresses horizontally across the image, while vertical position controls pitch. The Chandra X-ray Center’s September 2020 explanation describes a continuous range of pitches for the pillars and allows optical and X-ray versions to be heard separately or together. These are established features of the project, not techniques newly invented for the 2026 feature. The distinction between a renewed presentation and a new method helps keep the account precise.
paragraphs.translation: 在这件作品中，扫描线横向穿过图像，垂直位置则控制音高。钱德拉 X 射线中心 2020 年 9 月的说明介绍了柱状结构对应的连续音高范围，并提供可单独或同时聆听的可见光与 X 射线版本。这些是项目已有的特征，不是为 2026 年专题新发明的技术。区分重新展示与新方法，有助于保持叙述准确。

paragraphs.text: The central educational issue is the encoding. A listener cannot reliably interpret a rising note without knowing what that rise represents. Nor should an emotionally powerful sequence be treated as self-explanatory evidence. Once a mapping has been selected, it needs to be applied consistently and described clearly. Otherwise, an arbitrary choice may be mistaken for a property of the astronomical object. Explaining the relationship between data and sound is therefore part of the presentation itself, not an optional technical afterthought.
paragraphs.translation: 教育上的核心问题是编码方式。听者不知道升高的音符代表什么，就无法可靠地解释它。富有感染力的声音序列也不应被当作不言自明的证据。一旦选定映射关系，就需要一致应用并清楚说明，否则，任意的选择可能被误认为天体本身的性质。因此，解释数据与声音的关系是呈现本身的一部分，而不是可有可无的事后技术补充。

paragraphs.text: An alternative sensory route can also make information more accessible, but the benefit should not be presumed identical for all audiences. Some learners may notice a pattern through hearing; others may need a diagram or an explicit verbal description. Providing choices acknowledges these differences without requiring anyone to demonstrate a preferred way of sensing. Evaluation could ask whether people can explain a relationship afterwards, rather than whether they describe the experience as entertaining or impressive.
paragraphs.translation: 另一种感官路径也可能使信息更易接触，但不应假定所有受众获得相同益处。有些学习者可能通过聆听察觉规律，另一些则需要图示或明确的语言说明。提供选择承认这些差异，也无需任何人证明自己偏好的感知方式。评价可以考察人们事后能否解释一种关系，而不是只看他们是否觉得体验有趣或震撼。

paragraphs.text: A hypothetical classroom experiment would make this distinction concrete. Students could assign higher notes to higher temperatures in a small, familiar dataset. They would keep the mapping consistent, predict which changes should be audible, and then compare what they heard with the numerical record. If they later reversed the mapping, they would need to explain that change before comparing interpretations. The purpose would be to examine a representation, not to claim that temperature naturally produces a particular melody.
paragraphs.translation: 一个假设性的课堂实验可以把这种区别变得具体。学生可在一个小型、熟悉的数据集中，用更高音符表示更高气温。他们保持映射一致，预测哪些变化应当可以听见，再将所听内容与数字记录比较。如果后来反转映射，就需要先解释变化，再比较理解结果。目的在于检验一种呈现方式，而非声称温度天然会产生某段旋律。

paragraphs.text: Sound and sight can consequently be complementary routes into the same material. Neither format guarantees understanding, and neither removes the need to ask how observations have been transformed. The strongest presentation joins creative design to a traceable method, allowing an audience to enjoy an experience while examining its informational basis. That combination makes accessibility and intellectual care partners: more people can enter the discussion, and everyone has a clearer way to question what the presentation appears to show.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，声音与视觉可以成为接触相同材料的互补路径。任何一种形式都不能保证理解，也都不能免除人们追问观测如何被转换的责任。最有力的呈现把创意设计与可追溯方法结合起来，让受众在享受体验时也能检查其信息基础。这种结合让可及性与严谨思考相互支持：更多人可以参与讨论，所有人也都能更清楚地质疑展示似乎表达了什么。

focusWords.meaning: 编码；把信息转为特定形式的方式
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指将观测中的位置等数据对应到音高等声音特征的规则。

examples.text: The encoding assigns a different symbol to each category.
examples.translation: 这种编码为每个类别分配不同符号。

examples.text: Readers need to understand the encoding before they can interpret the chart.
examples.translation: 读者需要先理解编码方式，才能解释图表。

focusWords.meaning: 任意的；缺乏明确依据的
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指未交代依据的声音映射选择，不能误认为天体的固有性质。

examples.text: An arbitrary change in the rules made the results hard to compare.
examples.translation: 规则的任意改变使结果难以比较。

examples.text: The labels were chosen for a reason, rather than in an arbitrary order.
examples.translation: 标签按一定理由选定，而不是随意排列。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指声音与视觉可以共同帮助理解相同资料，不必互相取代。

examples.text: The two reports offer complementary views of the same event.
examples.translation: 两份报告为同一事件提供了互补视角。

examples.text: Written instructions and a practical demonstration play complementary roles.
examples.translation: 文字说明与实际演示发挥互补作用。

questions.prompt: What is the author’s main position on sonification?
options: Its chief educational value comes from avoiding technical explanations.
It can broaden engagement when the transformation of data remains understandable.
It should replace visual materials once a suitable melody has been produced.
Its emotional impact provides an independent test of scientific accuracy.
questions.explanation: 全文将声音化的参与价值与编码透明、一致应用、解释可核查联系起来，B 最完整。A 恰好省略了作者要求说明的转换规则；D 则以情绪效果代替证据。

questions.prompt: Which feature of the pillars’ sonification is described in paragraph 2?
options: Pitch changes are controlled by the listener’s distance from the screen.
The horizontal scan was invented specifically for the 2026 presentation.
The optical version must be removed before the X-ray version can be heard.
Vertical position determines pitch while the scan moves horizontally.
questions.explanation: 第二段区分了扫描方向与音高控制：扫描横向推进，垂直位置决定音高，故 D 正确。B 忽略 2020 年的方法说明；C 把“可分别或同时聆听”误写为必须互相排斥。

questions.prompt: Why does the author insist that the encoding be explained?
options: Listeners might otherwise confuse a design choice with a feature of the object.
Listeners need to recreate the spacecraft instruments before hearing the piece.
A clearer explanation makes every mapping equally suitable for all data.
The explanation determines whether the original observations were recent.
questions.explanation: 第三段说明未解释的任意选择可能被误认为天体本身的性质，A 是直接转述。C 过度扩大说明的作用：解释规则并不意味着所有映射都同样合适。

questions.prompt: Which finding would most directly support the educational value of a sonification?
options: Most listeners consider the soundtrack more dramatic than the picture.
Students agree that one sensory format should be required in every lesson.
Learners can accurately explain a data relationship after using the available formats.
A different melody attracts more attention despite an unexplained change of rules.
questions.explanation: 第四段提出应看学习者事后能否解释关系，C 因而最接近有效的学习证据。A、D 只显示吸引力，B 则违背提供不同感官路径的主张。

options: capable of producing identical sensory experiences
useful together in supporting understanding
in competition to become the single preferred format
independent of the information being represented
questions.explanation: 末段说声音和视觉是接触同一资料的两种路径，且任何一种都不保证理解，因此 complementary 指相互补充、共同有用，选 B。A 误将互补理解为体验相同，C 则误解为相互竞争。
